source.author: hor
source.text: si fractus illabatur orbis, inpavidum ferient ruinae.
source.text_original: si fractus illabatur orbis, / inpavidum ferient ruinae.
source.text_english: If the broken world should collapse, its ruins would strike him unafraid.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: et licet me sinistro Hibera excetra rumore dilaniet, non timebo hominum iudicium habiturus iudicem meum: si fractus illabatur orbis, inpauidum ferient ruinae.
reuse.text_original: et licet me sinistro Hibera excetra rumore dilaniet, non timebo hominum iudicium habiturus iudicem meum: si fractus illabatur orbis, inpauidum ferient ruinae.
reuse.text_english: And though the Iberian viper may tear me apart with a malign rumor, I shall not fear the judgment of men, since I am to have my own judge: if the shattered world should collapse, its ruins would strike me unafraid.
